title: PIC32CX SG12 clock tree
source: PIC32CX0525SG12 datasheet, PCR and VBAT-powered control chapters

nodes.label: Crystal 32.768 kHz
nodes.tooltip: 32.768 kHz crystal on XTAL1/XTAL2, or a single-ended clock on XTAL2 (VBAT_CLK32_EN.XOSEL).

nodes.label: 32KHZ_IN pin
nodes.tooltip: External 32.768 kHz clock on the 32KHZ_IN pin.

nodes.label: Always-on 32 kHz source
nodes.tooltip: The crystal is used only once a clock is detected on the crystal pins.

nodes.label: 32 kHz clock domain
nodes.tooltip: Without a clock on 32KHZ_IN the always-on source is selected automatically.

nodes.label: PLL 48 MHz
nodes.tooltip: 48 MHz main clock, locked to the 32 kHz clock domain.

nodes.label: SLOW_CLK /n
nodes.tooltip: Slow clock for PWM, tachometer and other low-speed blocks: 48 MHz / n (0 = off, 480 = 100 kHz).
